skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students have deep knowledge about basic legal regulations of labor law such as labor contracts, labor discipline, dispute resolution, and strikes.

Students can analyze and synthesize information on specific legal situations, use computers with internet connections to search for legal information, check the validity of legal regulations, and communicate effectively.
Students can apply group work skills and present and deliver presentations on specialized topics.
Students develop the ability to independently research, accumulate, and enhance their professional knowledge.
Students can prepare and deliver presentations on specialized topics and answer questions related to the presentation.
